paper.title: Agentix (early arXiv: Autellix): An Efficient Serving Engine for LLM Agents as General Programs

freeze.name: Agentix-PLAS Baseline Freeze v1
freeze.head: aa5a11ab871e050c9ba205b6c5cf4004d0a617f3
freeze.note: Formal arm = continuous PLAS, NON-PREEMPTIVE. Frozen at the commit that introduced the implementation.

faithful: PLAS: a call's priority is its program's completed LLM calls' cumulative service (Eq. 1)
lower attained service is scheduled first
adapted: priority-only port: the execution unit is a GPU node; placement, admission memory and model residency stay with the substrate
the hard benchmark service class precedes the PLAS score (substrate contract; Agentix publishes no such class)
service accounting counts completed GPU nodes' observed model-executor service (queued wait and model load excluded)
ATLAS optional variant recomputes the exact completed critical path; the paper keeps one inherited per-program scalar -- they coincide on serial programs
deviation: the preemptive MLFQ scheduler is NOT part of the formal arm: K queues, the decoding time quantum, in-call demotion and program-level anti-starvation all require request preemption / KV-cache swapping, which the node-atomic substrate cannot represent
engine-level batching, cross-engine routing and KV-locality load balancing are not reproduced
omissions: preemptive MLFQ / decoding quantum / in-call demotion
program-level anti-starvation (only in the non-preemptive discrete SENSITIVITY variant, not the formal arm)
cross-engine routing and KV-cache transfer cost

non_paper_variants.Agentix-Discrete-NoPreempt: non-preemptive discretisation + cross-call re-binning + anti-starvation; K=4 with train-only quantile edges; explicitly NOT the paper's mechanism

information_contract.reads: only job.completed (completed calls); the current ready node's resource estimates are inherited from the substrate
information_contract.never: future workflow structure, remaining work, or the realized template suffix
information_contract.note: the paper is non-clairvoyant; reading the future would be unfaithful

prohibited_after_freeze: the PLAS priority definition and the non-clairvoyance boundary
service accounting (completed GPU nodes' observed service, load excluded)
claiming the paper's preemptive scheduler is reproduced
